title: Asking for 1
lyrics_original:
Every day we say
השם אֶחָד

We say it in the morning
We say it late at night

We carry these words with us
We know them by heart
But knowing that He is One
Is only where we start

Because I look around me
And everything divides

I see the joy and sorrow
The wrong and the right

I see the doors that open
I see the ones that close

I see the things I understand
And all the things I don't

I see a thousand pieces
Scattered before my eyes

But maybe there is One
behind the thousand sides


Maybe I don't need
another answer

Maybe I don't need
another way

Maybe I need the eyes
to see the One

Inside the world
I see today


אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת השם
אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית השם
כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי
לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם השם
וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ


We call one moment blessing
Another one a loss

We call one road a victory
Another road a cross

We ask why this was given
We ask why that was taken

We wonder why some dreams arrive
And others leave us waiting

But what if every chapter
Belongs to one great story?

What if the things I cannot see
Are still within His glory?

What if the road I wanted
Was never meant to be?

And what if what I thought was broken
Was beyond what I could see?

I see a single moment
He sees the years to come

I see a single answer
He sees where it came from

I see the piece before me
He sees the picture whole

And maybe all I'm missing
Is the vision of the One


I don't need to call
the darkness light

I don't need to say
that wrong is right

I only need to know
that what I see

Is never all
there is to see


אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת השם
אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית השם
כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי
לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם השם
וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ


And maybe בֵּית השם
is closer than I thought

Not somewhere far away
Not somewhere I must find

This room can be His house
This street can be His home

The people that surround me
Are not outside His world

The laughter at the table
The silence after tears

The moments I remember
The moments I still fear

The day that brought me something
I never thought I'd see

The night I asked a question
And heard no answer back from me

It's all inside His house
It's all beneath His sky

And maybe I have spent my life
just trying to understand why

When what I really needed
was to learn how to remain

Inside the world He gave me
And see His hand again


Not asking for a world
without sorrow

Not asking for a road
without pain

But asking for the eyes
to recognize

That nothing here
is outside His name


אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת השם
אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית השם
כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי
לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם השם
וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ


And then he asks for נֹעַם
The beauty of השם

Not only when the road is bright
Not only when I understand

There is a deeper beauty
That I have never seen

A beauty in the waiting
A beauty in between

The beauty of a story
That only He can see

The beauty of a world
That isn't centered around me

The beauty of surrender
The beauty of אֱמוּנָה

To know that I am looking
From a very limited side

And still to look for beauty
Still to search for light

Still to know that every piece
belongs to something right

Not everything is easy
Not everything feels good

But maybe נֹעַם השם
is seeing more than I could


And then comes וּלְבַקֵּר
בְּהֵיכָלוֹ

Not just to enter
Not just to pass it by

But to look into the details
To open up my eyes

To see every small piece
And where it has its place

To see the hidden harmony
inside the whole creation

The things that seem unrelated
The things that seem apart

The road that crossed another road
The meeting of two hearts

The years that led to yesterday
The choices that led me here

The things I thought were accidents
The things I called unclear

To look again
And look again

Until the pieces start to show

That what I thought was separate
was never separate at all


אַחַת

Not one request.

אַחַת

Not one thing
among a thousand things.

אַחַת

The thing I am asking for
is אַחַת.

To see אֶחָד.

To see one world.

One story.

One truth.

One השם.

השם אֶחָד.

[Build]

I don't want a different world

I want different eyes

I don't need every question
answered tonight

I want to see the One
inside the things I see

I want to see the beauty
I could never see alone

I want to walk through His house
and finally know I'm home

אַחַת

אַחַת

השם אֶחָד


אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת השם
אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית השם
כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי
לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם השם
וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ


אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת השם
אוֹתָהּ אֲבַקֵּשׁ
שִׁבְתִּי בְּבֵית השם
כָּל יְמֵי חַיַּי
לַחֲזוֹת בְּנֹעַם השם
וּלְבַקֵּר בְּהֵיכָלוֹ


השם אֶחָד

אַחַת.

אֶחָד.

אַחַת שָׁאַלְתִּי מֵאֵת השם
about: Dovid HaMelech's tefila is dedicated to anyone who has ever looked at life and seen a thousand pieces that did not seem to belong together. One story behind the moments we understand and the moments we cannot. We may not need a different world; perhaps what we need is different eyes.

title: Bonds of Darkness
lyrics_original:
Before I ever had a name
Before I ever had to fight
I knew the palace of the King
I knew the endless halls of light
No hunger there, no fear to face
No storm that shook the golden floor
I had the comfort of Your house
But You were calling me for more

So You sent me to the dust
Where the road is hard to see
Where the night can feel so long
And the battle looks like me
Where the body pulls me down
Where the heart forgets the song
Where I have to choose Your hand
When the dark is deep and strong

גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי

There are friends who share a table
There are brothers born as one
But there's a bond that only forms
Through the smoke before the sun
When the night comes down around you
And the ground begins to shake
When the one who stands beside you
Does not leave and does not break

That is how I came to know You
Not from palace, crown, or throne
But from every valley moment
When I thought I walked alone
You were there inside the darkness
You were there inside the flame
Not above me in the distance
But beside me, calling my name

גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי

יָפָה שָׁעָה אַחַת בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
בִּתְשׁוּבָה וּמַעֲשִׂים טוֹבִים
מִכָּל חַיֵּי הָעוֹלָם הַבָּא
There the soul could only see You
Here the soul can hold You tight
There I stood inside Your glory
Here I reach for You in the night

The palace showed Your greatness
In a world where angels shine
But the shadows gave me closeness
When Your hand was holding mine
Not because the pain was precious
Not because the dark was sweet
But because You stood there with me
When I could barely find my feet

And when I come back to the palace
And I stand inside Your glow
It will be the darkest memories
That make the rivers overflow
Every fear I walked through with You
Every night I did not flee
Every valley where I found You
Will become eternity

גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי

I knew Your light before I came
But now I know Your hand
For You were with me in the valley
Where I finally learned to stand
גַּם כִּי אֵלֵךְ בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת
לֹא אִירָא רָע כִּי אַתָּה עִמָּדִי
about:
If our neshama was already so close to Hashem in Gan Eden, why did it need to leave that perfection and enter a world of struggle and uncertainty?
While the neshama knew Hashem's greatness in Gan Eden, it can only experience the unique closeness that comes from choosing Him through life's challenges, holding His hand in the valleys, and walking with faith. Inspired by Tehilim 23 and Chazal, the song reminds us that our greatest connection to Hashem is often forged not in Gan Eden, but in the journey through the darkness.

title: Fires Still Burning
lyrics_original:
Rome burned the House
Titus at the gate

יְרוּשָׁלַיִם fell
Menorah in chains

Hadrian renamed us
Aelia on the stones

בַּר כּוֹכְבָא rose
Caves and broken bones

Torah in whispers
Decrees in the air

A nation in Galus
Still saying the prayer


The fires kept burning
They never died down

New robes, new reasons
The same old hate

We thought it was over
Then it came back again

Still Hashem remembers
Still מָשִׁיחַ will reign

Crusaders came marching
Rhineland ran red

Mothers said שְׁמַע
With children in bed

Blood libels followed
Norwich lit the flame

Talmud burning
Paris knew the shame

York in the tower
England closed the gate

Spain lit its candles
Inquisition fate

The fires kept burning
They never died down

New robes, new reasons
The same old hate

We thought it was over
Then it came back again

Still Hashem remembers
Still מָשִׁיחַ will reign


Black Death came sweeping
The wells took the blame

Keys left in pockets
Exile before flame

Ghetto walls tightened
Venice at the gate

Cossacks came riding
תַּח V'Taht fate

Europe grew modern
Dreyfus in chains

Rights on the paper
Kishinev in flames


The fires kept burning
They never died down

New robes, new reasons
The same old hate

We thought it was over
Then it came back again

Still Hashem remembers
Still מָשִׁיחַ will reign


Brown shirts were marching
Books in the street

Yellow stars sewn on
Where hearts used to beat

Trains in the morning
Smoke in the sky

The world heard the wheels
And let them roll by

Germany had culture
Siberia had snow

Sidurim hidden
Where no one could know


The fires kept burning
They never died down

New robes, new reasons
The same old hate

We thought it was over
Then it came back again

Still Hashem remembers
Still מָשִׁיחַ will reign

[Verse 5 - Israel and modern enemies]

After the ashes
A flag finally flew

But ash still remembers
When the sky turns blue

Armies surrounded
Forty-eight dawn

Sirens kept screaming
Sixty-seven song

Rockets from Gaza
Tunnels below

Hezbollah waiting
Litani still flows


The fires kept burning
They never died down

New robes, new reasons
The same old hate

We thought it was over
Then it came back again

Still Hashem remembers
Still מָשִׁיחַ will reign


Tehran kept chanting
Centrifuges spun

Deals kept delaying
The moment to run

Missiles were rising
Proxies in line

The tyrant still standing
And calling it time

Campuses shouted
Masks in the crowd

Professors stayed silent
The lies got loud

City halls smiling
Mamdani on screens

Old fear dressed up
In political means


Not Trump
Not Bibi

Not generals
Not kings

Not drones
Not speeches

Not iron wings

We are still in Galus
Even under our flag

Still reading the headlines
Still carrying the bag


Rome had its eagles
Spain had its fire

Germany had culture
Iran has desire

Every generation
Thought this was the end

But Hashem never forgot us
And He will rise again


The fires kept burning
They never died down

But we kept returning
Through every crown

They thought it was over
They thought we would end

Still Hashem remembers
Still מָשִׁיחַ will reign


אֲנִי מַאֲמִין
The road has been long

אֲנִי מַאֲמִין
We still carry the song

No king of flesh
Will heal every scar

Hashem has not forgotten
גְּאֻלָּה is not far


The fires kept burning
They never died down

But dawn is still coming

מָשִׁיחַ will reign
about: This song traces nearly 2,000 years of Jewish history, from the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash to the challenges facing the Jewish people today. It follows a painful pattern: empires fall, rulers change, and the faces of antisemitism evolve, but the hatred remains the same. Yet above every chapter of exile stands an unshakable truth. Hashem has never forgotten His people, and despite the long road of Galus, we continue to believe that the final redemption will come with the arrival of Mashiach.

title: Holy Land Vacation
lyrics_original:
The WhatsApp group started six months before
Nobody knows how it got so big

A hundred messages before breakfast
Forty opinions before lunch

Grandma wants a quiet hotel
The kids want something fun

Dad has a spreadsheet open
With a plan for everyone

King David has the view
Citadel is the place

Waldorf has the lobby
Where everybody knows your face

Someone says:
"Don't forget יְרוּשָׁלַיִם"

Someone says:
"The Shuk is a must"

Someone says:
"Whatever we do..."

"Please don't make us rush"


מִיָּם וּמִזְרָח
וּמִצָּפוֹן וְתֵימָן

שְׁלוֹם רָחוֹק וְקָרוֹב
שְׂאִי מִכֹּל עֲבָרָיִךְ

From the west and from the east
From the north and from the south

From far away and from nearby
Your children call from every route



We walked through the Shuk
With a serious plan

A map in our pocket
Food in our hands

Kiyurtush spinning
Kinafah in the air

Chachapuri from the oven
Everybody wants to share

דָּנִי פִּצּוּחִים calling:

"Come inside, it doesn't cost a lot"

We walked out forty minutes later

With something we forgot we bought

Falafel Moz for lunch
Halo Teiman at night

Kraft Pizza with the kids

Because somehow that feels right

Katzefet after dinner
Crave when it's late

Entrecote for the big night

Waffle Bar before the gate



מִיָּם וּמִזְרָח
וּמִצָּפוֹן וְתֵימָן

שְׁלוֹם רָחוֹק וְקָרוֹב
שְׂאִי מִכֹּל עֲבָרָיִךְ



We came for the restaurants
We came for the view

We came for the places
Everybody told us to do

Rimon for the evening
Rodriguez with friends

Skyline on the calendar

Three months before it begins

Everyone knows better:

"My idea  is the best one here "

And somehow every argument ends:

"We're coming back next year"



Then somebody said:

"Enough eating"

"Let's see the land"

So we traded the tablecloth

For the desert sand

Benzi Jeeping through the mountains

Dust flying everywhere

Caliber 3 with M16s

Adventure filling the air

Eretz Bereishis camels on the cliff

Stories carved into the stone

We thought we came for a thrill

We didn't know what we'd find at home



Then תַּנַךְ Warriors

The ultimate fun

"It's only two hours"

"Something fun for the kids"

Then Grandma grabbed the sword

Shedding decades when she did

Mom picked up the bow and arrow

The kids started laughing:

"Who's going first?"

Ancient weapons
Ancient stories

The whole family joined the fight

We came looking for an activity

We found something that felt alive



שִׁנְעָר וּפַתְרוֹס
הֲיַעַרְכוּךְ בְּגָדְלָם?

וְאִם הֶבְלָם יְדַמּוּ
לְתֻמַּיִךְ וְאוּרָיִךְ?

Can Babylon and Egypt compare?

Can all the wonders of the world match you?



We went to Fiji for the beaches

Dubai for the gold

Paris had the fashion

Prague stories to be told

Every place was beautiful

Every place had something new

Every place gave memories

Every place had a view

But nobody says:

"Let's go back again"

Nobody counts the months

Nobody feels that pull inside

That brings you back again



Maybe it wasn't the hotel

Maybe it wasn't the food

Maybe it wasn't the schedule

Or everything we thought we knew

The eyes came looking for pleasure

The body came looking for rest

But the soul was quietly searching

For the place it knows best

The world gives moments

The soul remembers home



וּכְבוֹד הַשֵּׁם לְבַד
הָיָה מְאוֹרֵךְ

וְאֵין שֶׁמֶשׁ וְסַהַר
וְכוֹכָבִים מְאִירָיִךְ

Your light was never from the sun

Never from the moon

Never from the stars

We thought we came for a vacation

Our soul knew where we are



The taxi was terrible

The traffic didn't move

Someone cut the line

Someone lost a shoe

The weather was crazy

The schedule fell apart

And everyone was smiling...

Because יְרוּשָׁלַיִם had already found their heart
about: Every traveler thinks they came to Israel for something different. Somewhere between the Shuk and the Judean hills, the soul quietly remembers why it really came. It came to enjoy the warmth of Home.

title: Jewish USA
lyrics_original:
Newport harbor, Touro walls
Seixas writes, Washington calls

Charleston streets, Savannah air
Early minyans, whispered prayer

Haym Salomon, Revolution
New-world dream, Constitution

Ports were open, roads were wide
Torah packed for the other side

[Verse 1]

Ellis Island, steerage lines
Tenement rooms and Yiddish signs

Orchard pushcarts, factory floors
Shabbos clocks and bolted doors

Freedom called, but freedom cost
Friday jobs and paychecks lost

Kosher butcher, mikvah door
Little shuls above the store

Yiddish papers, Hebrew schools
New-world streets and old-world rules

Rent was steep, the stairways thin
Still the next day would begin

[Chorus -

Two hundred fifty years
Look what grew here year by year

From harbor lights
To city heights

A thousand roads
A thousand lives

And still
We’re here

[Instrumental Hook - piano riff, bright synth line, guitar punctuation]

[Verse 2]

Irving Berlin, Gershwin scores
Broadway lights and theater doors

Einstein thinking, Princeton halls
Jonas Salk and hospital walls

Levi Strauss and garment trades
Storefront signs and window shades

Greenberg swinging, Koufax heat
Yom Kippur and empty seats

Hollywood screens, radio sound
Jewish names all over town

Doctors, lawyers, writers, plays
Building lives in different ways

[Chorus 
Two hundred fifty years
Look what grew here year by year

From harbor lights
To city heights

A thousand roads
A thousand lives

And still
We’re here

[Verse 3]

Soldiers serving, victory trains
Europe shattered, names in flames

Refugee ships, a suitcase tied
Family pictures tucked inside

Israel rising, bonds were sold
Soviet rallies in the cold

Signs held high beneath the sky
Let my people go, the cry

Brooklyn, Queens and Jersey lanes
Boro Park and Monsey trains

Camps and schools and kosher aisles
Suburban shuls for twenty miles

[Verse 4]

Flatbush nights and Five Towns days
Teaneck traffic, Passaic ways

Deal and Boca, Lakewood streets
Miami winters, wedding seats

Wall Street calls and startup plans
Hatzalah racing, helping hands

Daf on trains and red-eye flights
Shabbos tables, Friday nights

WhatsApp buzzing, weddings packed
Suitcase seforim neatly stacked

Different accents, different views
One enormous world of Jews

[Chorus]

Two hundred fifty years
Look what grew here year by year

From harbor lights
To city heights

A thousand roads
A thousand lives

And still
We’re here

[Final Section]

But underneath the rush
And underneath the fame

Beneath the lights
And beneath the names

The ballparks
The boardrooms

The books
The acclaim

There was always something deeper
Than the American dream

A Torah carried from Sinai

Across the sea
Through every mile

From father to son
From mother to child

From rebbe to talmid
From generation to generation

Would the Torah cross the ocean?

Would the chain remain unbroken?

Would an American child
Open a Gemara

And hear
The voice of Sinai?


Torah Vodaath
Chaim Berlin

Mir and Telz
Rebuilt again

Bais Yaakov
Class by class

Torah Umesorah
Spreading fast

Agudah standing
Vaad Hatzalah

Rav Moshe’s teshuvos
Rav Aharon’s fire

Lakewood rising
Shtenders full

Torah growing
School by school

ArtScroll pages
Daf Yomi trains

A Torah nation
Built again

From Sinai
To Brooklyn

From Brooklyn
To Lakewood

From Lakewood
To every city

The promise
Carried through

Two hundred fifty years

A thousand roads

One Torah

[Outro - huge sustained landing, strong final vocal, no fade]

Still learning

Still building

Still here

The Torah did not merely survive America

It grew here

It grew here
about: In honor of the 250th Birthday of the United States, the Malchus Shel Chesed.

title: Rising Like Lions
lyrics_original:
We were never born to disappear
In the noise of every crowd
Never made to trade our fire
For the songs they sing out loud

Not to chase another kingdom
Not to wear another name
Not to bow before their mirrors
Not to live inside their game


But alone is not the answer
And divided is not strong
A lion does not rise alone
A people rises as one

הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב
הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא

Every lion knows the circle
Every lion knows the ground
One will watch and one will listen
One will move without a sound

No one has to hold the whole pride
No one has to stand alone
Every heart has its mission
Every soul has its own throne


When brother turns to brother
And the broken hands are tied
The sleeping strength awakens
And the lion starts to rise

הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב

They can offer us their towers
They can dress their chains in gold
They can tell us we are stronger
When our ancient name grows cold

But the blessing came from Heaven
Through a mouth that came to curse
And he saw a lonely nation
That would never need the world


Not lonely from each other
Not scattered in the heart
Only separate from the darkness
Only holy, set apart

הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב
הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא

One tribe carries memory
One tribe carries flame
One tribe guards the doorway
One tribe sings the Name

One will learn in silence
One will fight for truth
One will lift the fallen
One will guide the youth

Not the same, but together
Not erased, but one
Not a crowd of copies
But a nation like the sun


When we stop chasing shadows
And remember who we are
When we hold on to each other
We can rise beyond the stars

When the camp becomes one heartbeat
And the Torah is our cry
Then the lion wakes inside us
And no power can deny

הֶן עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן וּבַגּוֹיִם לֹא יִתְחַשָּׁב

Separate from the nations
United as one
Every soul in its place
Till the lion has risen
הֶן עָם כְּלָבִיא יָקוּם וְכַאֲרִי יִתְנַשָּׂא
about: There are two messages in this prophecy. We are called to remain separate from the nations, but inseparable from one another. When those two truths come together, the Lion within Am Yisrael awakens and  becomes unstoppable.

lyrics_original:
I asked for בְּרָכוֹת everywhere
With a dollar and a worried face

I tried סְגֻלּוֹת old and new
Just to keep the bills in place

I tied the red string extra tight
Hung a חַמְסָה by the door

Baked the key inside the חַלָּה
Then I baked another four

I checked the name, I checked the מַזָּל
Asked a מְקֻבָּל what he saw

I bought the charm in silver letters
And called it הִשְׁתַּדְּלוּת by law

I said פֶּרֶק שִׁירָה at sunrise
With a whisper and a plea

And פָּרָשַׁת הַמָּן on Super Tuesday
Like it held the master key


Every coin has one address
Every dollar has one King

You can run the whole wide world
But only He can make it ring


אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם
אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם

הַשֵּׁם חָפֵץ לְמַעַן צִדְקוֹ
יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר

הַשֵּׁם חָפֵץ לְמַעַן צִדְקוֹ
יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר


My calendar is full of flights
Like Heaven runs on points and miles

אוּמַן in the winter cold
קֶרֶעסטִיר with hopeful smiles

לִיזֶענְסְק before the dawn
Another קֶבֶר, another line

I’m chasing every holy stop
To make the פַּרְנָסָה shine


I chased a tip from cousin Shloimy
Who heard from someone in Flatbush

There’s a deal that’s almost closing
Just don’t ask too much, just push

I bought the course, I joined the webinar
“Seven secrets rich men know”

But if the money has no mission
Tell me, where’s it meant to go?


Maybe wealth is not a trophy
Maybe blessing has a job

Maybe gold is only holy
When it lifts the name of G-d

If I want it for my comfort
Then the money tests my hand

If I want it for His honor
Then the money understands


אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם
אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם

הַשֵּׁם חָפֵץ לְמַעַן צִדְקוֹ
יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר

הַשֵּׁם חָפֵץ לְמַעַן צִדְקוֹ
יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר


Some men get rich and build a palace
Some men get rich and build a name

Some men get rich and lose their children
While they’re busy winning games

Some men get rich and feed the hungry
Some men hold a יְשִׁיבָה wall

Same green bills, two different stories
One stands tall, one starts to fall


At the end of every ledger
When the numbers fade away

All the silver, all the velvet
Cannot buy one honest day

There is something more than diamonds
More than houses, more than gold

יְקָרָה הִיא מִפְּנִינִים
That’s the treasure we must hold


Money comes and money wanders
תּוֹרָה stays and lights the years

If the wealth can serve the תּוֹרָה
Then the blessing becomes clear


Lead: Who gives the money?
Group: Only הַשֵּׁם

Lead: Why send the money?
Group: For His name

Lead: What is the mission?
Group: תּוֹרָה and light

Lead: What is the test?
Group: Spend it right


אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם
אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם

יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר

יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר


I tried the סְגֻלּוֹת, chased the signs
From door to door, from shore to shore

But if it’s meant to lift His תּוֹרָה
He can send a whole lot more

אִם חָפֵץ בָּנוּ הַשֵּׁם
יַגְדִּיל תּוֹרָה וְיַאְדִּיר
about: We've all been there. Looking for one more segulah, one more tefillah, one more trick to open the gates of parnasah. Then one day you realize... the gate was never the problem.

title: She Carried Me
lyrics_original:
Before I had a name
she carried all my frame

Before I saw the light
she held me through the night

Before I had a voice
she made the harder choice

Before I knew her face
she made her heart my place

She carried me
before I learned to breathe

She carried me
when I was small and weak

Before I had a voice
before I had a plea

She carried me
she carried me


She heard the smallest cry
before I knew the why

She woke before the dawn
and kept the blanket on

She gave before she ate
she hurried when I’d wait

She held me to her chest
and gave away her rest

She carried me
before I learned to breathe

She carried me
when I was small and weak

Before I had a voice
before I had a plea

She carried me
she carried me

She carried bags and coats
and half-remembered notes

She carried shoes and tears
and fevers through the years

She carried every plan
the world would never scan

The lunches and the calls
the worry in the halls


She carried prayers at night
that never reached my sight

She carried dreams for me
before I learned to see

She carried every ache
I did not know could break

She carried what I hid
when I was just a kid


She carried me
before I learned to breathe

She carried me
when I was small and weak

Before I had a voice
before I had a plea

She carried me
she carried me


And maybe years went by
with words we can’t deny

And maybe hearts can bruise
from roads we did not choose

But underneath the pain
one truth will still remain

Before I stood alone
she carried flesh and bone


Before I judged her ways
before my grown-up days

Before I answered back
before I saw the lack

Before I found my ground
before I wore my crown

Before I learned to stand
she carried me by hand

She carried me
before I learned to breathe

She carried me
when I was small and weak

Before I had a voice
before I had a plea

She carried me
she carried me

She carried me
when I could not stand

Now I carry her honor
with my heart and my hands

She carried me
before I knew her name

Now I carry her dignity
and never call it shame

She carried me
when I could not stand

Now I carry her honor
with my heart and my hands

She carried me
she carried me
about: This song is dedicated to every mother, and to the day a child finally understands that the woman who carried them deserves to have her honor carried by them.

title: The Walls Fall First
lyrics_original:
The city did not fall at once
The flames had not yet climbed
The stones were still standing tall
The gold still seemed to shine

But something broke before the fire
Something opened in the wall
And once the outside entered in
The inside felt the fall

The wall falls first
The wall falls first
Before the fire
The wall falls first

A Mikdash does not fall in a moment
A heart does not break in a day
First there is a little opening
Where the holiness slips away

First I let the noise come in
First I let the border go
Then I wonder why the flame inside
Does not burn the way I know


The wall falls first
The wall falls first
Before the shame
The wall falls first


עִיר פְּרוּצָה אֵין חוֹמָה
אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר אֵין מַעְצָר לְרוּחוֹ
A city open to every wind
A heart with nowhere safe to go

I thought no walls meant freedom
I thought no gates meant light
But every voice became my master
Every desire claimed the right


Build me a wall
Not of fear, not of stone
Build me a heart
That can guard what is its own

If the gates are broken open
Then the holy starts to fall
Before the Mikdash burns
There is a breach inside the wall


So we fast before the burning
We cry before the flame
For the day the wall was broken
Was the day we lost the frame

Still the city had its towers
Still the courtyards had their song
But when kedushah has no border
It cannot stand for long



The wall falls first
The wall falls first
Before the fire
The wall falls first


Some men build their walls from money
Some men build their walls from pride
Some men hide behind their anger
And call it strength inside

But gold is only imagination
And pride is only sand
A real wall is self-control
And a soul that knows to stand


Build me a wall
Not of fear, not of stone
Build me a heart
That can guard what is its own

If the gates are broken open
Then the holy starts to fall
Before the Mikdash burns
There is a breach inside the wall


I do not ask for walls of coldness
I do not ask to close my eyes
I ask for holy borders
Where the inner fire survives

Teach me when to close the gate
Teach me when to turn away
Teach me how to hold the line
Before the ruin has its day


Rebuild the walls of Yerushalayim
Rebuild the walls inside of me
Close the cracks where I went wandering
Guard the place where I am free

Let the outside stay outside
Let the holy live within
Let the city rise from ashes
Let the healing now begin


Build me a wall
Not of fear, not of stone
Build me a heart
That can guard what is its own

If the gates are broken open
Then the holy starts to fall
Before the Mikdash burns
There is a breach inside the wall


וַאֲנִי אֶהְיֶה לָּהּ
נְאֻם הַשֵּׁם
חוֹמַת אֵשׁ
סָבִיב
וּלְכָבוֹד
אֶהְיֶה בְתוֹכָהּ
וַאֲנִי אֶהְיֶה לָּהּ
חוֹמַת אֵשׁ סָבִיב
about: Yerushalayim wasn't destroyed when the flames rose into the sky. It was destroyed the day the enemy found an opening. Every heart has walls. Every soul has gates. And every battle begins there.

title: The Year Is Waiting
lyrics_original:
Another year is closing

I can almost see it go

Twelve months that I was given

Some I used, some I let go

There were days I made a difference

There were days I missed the mark

There were doors I should have opened

There were chances left in the dark

And now the year is ending

And another one begins

Before I ask for anything

I have to look at where I've been

Because Rosh Hashanah comes

And suddenly I understand


This isn't just another date

Another number on the calendar


I'm standing here

With everything I've done

And everything I still can become



כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם

עוֹבְרִין לְפָנָיו

כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן


כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם

עוֹבְרִין לְפָנָיו

כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן


And the year is waiting

For what I'll do with it

Every year I make a plan

Every year I make a list

Here is what I want to change

Here is everything I missed

Here is what I want to build

Here is where I want to grow

Here are all the things I need

And all the things I hope will come

I can tell You what I'm hoping

I can tell You what I need

I can make my case for tomorrow

I can tell You what I want to achieve


But then I hear the words of Chazal

And suddenly I understand

I can make the plans

I can make the case

But I don't decide

What will be placed in my hands


There is a measure

There is a plan

There is a year

I don't understand

I can ask

I can dream

I can prepare

For what will be



כָּל מְזוֹנוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָדָם

קְצוּבִין לוֹ

מֵרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

וְעַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים


כָּל מְזוֹנוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָדָם

קְצוּבִין לוֹ

מֵרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

וְעַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים


So what am I asking for?


Not simply more

Not simply less


Give me what You know I need

To become what I can become

If You give me more

Let me know what to do with more


If You give me less

Let me not become less

If a door opens

Give me courage to walk through

If something closes

Give me strength to walk another road


I don't control

What comes into my life

But I can decide

What I do with what arrives

And then I remember

הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם

Today

The world begins again


And maybe that's why

I get another chance

Not because yesterday didn't happen

It did

I carry it with me

But it doesn't have to be

The final word


A new year


A new page


A new chance

Not to become somebody else

But to become

More of who I was meant to be


כָּל מְזוֹנוֹתָיו שֶׁל אָדָם

קְצוּבִין לוֹ

מֵרֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה

וְעַד יוֹם הַכִּפּוּרִים


הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם


A new year is opening

A new year is mine to live


כָּל בָּאֵי עוֹלָם

עוֹבְרִין לְפָנָיו

כִּבְנֵי מָרוֹן


And I'm standing here

With another year

Another chance

Another beginning


הַיּוֹם הֲרַת עוֹלָם


A new year

A new beginning

A year I haven't lived yet

And I'm ready
about: This song is dedicated to the moment we stand between the year that was and the year that is about to begin. Rosh Hashanah is not only a time to ask for what we want, it is a time to recognize that every year is a gift, every person is judged, and every new beginning carries the possibility of becoming more of who we were meant to be.

title: אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי
lyrics_original:
יֵשׁ פַּחַד שֶׁבָּא בְּשֶׁקֶט כְּשֶׁהַשָּׁנִים מִתְקָרְבוֹת
כְּשֶׁהַצְּעָדִים קְצָת כְּבֵדִים וְהַיָּדַיִם רוֹעֲדוֹת
פַּעַם אֲנִי נָשָׂאתִי וְעַכְשָׁיו אוֹתִי נוֹשְׂאִים

אֲבָל אֵין זֶה סוֹף הַדֶּרֶךְ וְאֵין זֶה סוֹף הַשִּׁיר
כִּי יֵשׁ בִּי עוֹד מַה לָתֵת וְיֵשׁ בִּי עוֹד לְהָאִיר

אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי
אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי

יֵשׁ לִי צַלָּקוֹת בַּלֵּב שֶׁנַּעֲשׂוּ לִי תּוֹרָה
יֵשׁ לִי מִלְחָמוֹת בַּנֶּפֶשׁ שֶׁאַף אֶחָד לֹא רָאָה
יֵשׁ לִי שָׁנִים שֶׁל עֲבוֹדָה בַּתְּפִלָּה וּבַנְּשָׁמָה
לְהִתְקָרֵב אֵלֶיךָ גַּם כְּשֶׁגּוּפִי שׁוֹקֵעַ בִּדְמָמָה

וְאִם אֵינֶנִּי רָץ כְּמוֹ אָז וְאִם קוֹלִי כְּבָר לֹא גָּדוֹל
כָּל מִלָּה שֶׁאֲנִי נוֹתֵן עוֹד יְכוֹלָה לִפְתֹּחַ כֹּל

אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי
אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי

עוֹד יְנוּבוּן בְּשֵׂיבָה דְּשֵׁנִים וְרַעֲנַנִּים יִהְיוּ

וְכָל מַה שֶׁבָּנִיתִי בְּכֹחַ וּבִתְפִלָּה יִמְשִׁיךְ לָלֶכֶת גַּם כְּשֶׁאֲנִי כְּבָר לֹא אוּכַל

אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי
אַל תַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי לְעֵת זִקְנָה כִּכְלוֹת כֹּחִי אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי

גַּם כְּשֶׁאֵין בִּי כֹּחַ תֵּן לִי עוֹד לָתֵת
גַּם כְּשֶׁאֵין בִּי כֹּחַ אַל תַּעַזְבֵנִי כָּעֵת
lyrics_translation:
There's a fear that comes quietly as the years get closer,
when the steps get a little heavy and the hands start to shake.
Once I used to carry others, now they carry me.
Once I used to lead, now people explain things to me.

But this isn't the end of the road, and it isn't the end of the song,
because I still have something to give, I still have something to light up.

Don't cast me aside in old age, don't abandon me when my strength fails.
Don't cast me aside in old age, don't abandon me when my strength fails.

I have scars on my heart that became my Torah.
I have battles in my soul that no one ever saw.
I have years of work in prayer and in soul,
drawing close to You even as my body sinks into stillness.

And if I don't run like I used to, and if my voice isn't loud anymore,
every word I still give can still open everything.

Don't cast me aside in old age, don't abandon me when my strength fails.
Don't cast me aside in old age, don't abandon me when my strength fails.

And even to old age and grey hair, God, don't abandon me,
until I tell of Your strength to the next generation, Your might to all who come.
There's still something to hand down, something to leave behind,
there's a fire of years that can still give light.

They will still flourish in old age, full of sap and green,
to declare that God is upright, my Rock, in whom there is no wrong.
If I don't have the strength to build, I have the wisdom to guide.
If I don't have the strength to run, I have light to keep going.

And what I learned in blood and tears will pass to the next generation and bloom a hundredfold.
And everything I built with strength and prayer will keep walking even when I no longer can.

Don't cast me aside in old age, don't abandon me when my strength fails.
Don't cast me aside in old age, don't abandon me when my strength fails.

Even when I have no strength left, let me still give.
Even when I have no strength left, don't abandon me now.
about: A candle burns brightest just before the night grows dark. The later years of life aren't meant to be an epilogue. They're where wisdom becomes someone else's future.

title: אֱמֶת לַאֲמִתּוֹ
lyrics_original:
אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ אֶת הָאֱמֶת אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ לְאָן לָלֶכֶת
אֲבָל הָרַגְלַיִם עוֹד כְּבֵדוֹת וַאֲנִי עוֹד לוֹמֵד לָלֶכֶת
יֵשׁ עוֹפֶרֶת בְּרַגְלַי וְהַשָּׁמַיִם קוֹרְאִים אֵלַי
אֲנִי פּוֹרֵשׂ אֶת הַכְּנָפַיִם וְשׁוּב נוֹפֵל עַל הַבִּרְכַּיִם

אֲנִי צָרִיךְ לְהִשְׁתַּנּוֹת הָאֱמֶת לֹא מִשְׁתַּנָּה
גַּם אִם נָפַלְתִּי עוֹד הַפַּעַם מָחָר שׁוּב אֲנַסֶּה

הָאֱמֶת לֹא מִשְׁתַּנָּה רַק אֲנִי צָרִיךְ לְהִשְׁתַּנּוֹת
אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים עוֹד אֶפֹּל אֶלֶף פְּעָמִים אֲנַסֶּה לַעֲלוֹת
הָאֱמֶת לֹא מִשְׁתַּנָּה לֹא בְּכִשָּׁלוֹן וְלֹא בְּהַצְלָחוֹת
אֲנִי עֲדַיִן לֹא שָׁם אֲבָל אֶת הָאֱמֶת לֹא אֶעֱזֹב

כְּבָר הִתְרַגַּלְתִּי לְעַצְמִי לַדְּרָכִים שֶׁלֹּא עוֹזְבוֹת אוֹתִי
לַתֵּרוּצִים הַיְּשָׁנִים לַקּוֹלוֹת שֶׁמַּרְגִּיעִים אוֹתִי
כָּל כָּךְ קַל לוֹמַר זֶה פָּשׁוּט מִי שֶׁאֲנִי
אֲבָל אֲנִי לֹא מוֹרִיד אֶת הָרָף כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּתְאִים לִי

אֲנִי צָרִיךְ לְהִשְׁתַּנּוֹת הָאֱמֶת לֹא מִשְׁתַּנָּה
גַּם אִם נָפַלְתִּי עוֹד הַפַּעַם מָחָר שׁוּב אֲנַסֶּה

אֲנִי עֲדַיִן לֹא שָׁם אֲבָל אֶת הָאֱמֶת לֹא אֶעֱזֹב

גַּם כְּשֶׁאֲנִי נוֹפֵל הָאֱמֶת נִשְׁאֶרֶת עוֹמֶדֶת
הִיא לֹא בִּקְּשָׁה שֶׁאֶהְיֶה מֻשְׁלָם רַק שֶׁלֹּא אֶעֱזֹב אֶת הַדֶּרֶךְ

עוֹד פַּעַם אֶפֹּל עוֹד פַּעַם אָקוּם עוֹד פַּעַם אֶכָּשֵׁל עוֹד פַּעַם אָשׁוּב

מוּטָב לִי לְהִכָּשֵׁל וְלִחְיוֹת עִם הָאוֹר
מוּטָב לִי לְהִכָּשֵׁל וְלִחְיוֹת בָּאֱמֶת
מִלְּהַצְלִיחַ בַּכֹּל וְלִחְיוֹת בְּתוֹךְ שֶׁקֶר

אֲנִי עֲדַיִן לֹא שָׁם אֲבָל אֶת הָאֱמֶת לֹא אֶעֱזֹב
lyrics_translation:
I know the truth, I know where to go,
but my legs are still heavy, and I'm still learning to walk.
There's lead in my feet and the sky is calling me.
I spread my wings and fall on my knees again.

I need to change. The truth doesn't change.
Even if I fell again this time, tomorrow I'll try again.

The truth doesn't change, only I need to change.
A thousand times I'll still fall, a thousand times I'll try to rise.
The truth doesn't change — not in failure, not in success.
I'm still not there, but I won't abandon the truth.

I've already gotten used to myself, to the habits that won't let go of me,
to the old excuses, to the voices that soothe me.
It's so easy to say "this is just who I am,"
but I won't lower the bar just to make myself comfortable.

I need to change. The truth doesn't change.
Even if I fell again this time, tomorrow I'll try again.

The truth doesn't change, only I need to change.
A thousand times I'll still fall, a thousand times I'll try to rise.
The truth doesn't change — not in failure, not in success.
I'm still not there, but I won't abandon the truth.

Even when I fall, the truth stays standing.
It never asked me to be perfect — only not to abandon the path.

I'll fall again, I'll get up again, I'll fail again, I'll come back again.

And on that final day, when I look back,
better to have failed and lived with the light,
better to have failed and lived in truth,
than to have succeeded at everything and lived inside a lie.

The truth doesn't change, only I need to change.
A thousand times I'll still fall, a thousand times I'll try to rise.
The truth doesn't change — not in failure, not in success.
I'm still not there, but I won't abandon the truth.

I'm still not there, but I won't abandon the truth.
about:
The Dubno Maggid says that the best way to ensure that you hit the bullseye is to first shoot the arrow and then paint the bullseye around it. 

This song is dedicated to all the heroes who don't ever change their targets based on where their arrows landed. These heroes know the truth and stick to the truth, no matter how many times they fail. They never give up, and never abandon their quest for the real truth.

title: ברכי נפשי
lyrics_original:
הַמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכוּ
טִפָּה יוֹרֶדֶת מִן הַשָּׁמַיִם וְהָאָרֶץ מְחַיֶּכֶת בַּשְּׂדֵה
רוּחַ עוֹבֶרֶת בֵּין הָעֵצִים וְהָעָלִים מְלַחֲשִׁים שִׁירָה
אֶבֶן בַּדֶּרֶךְ צֵל מִן הַסֶּלַע וְהַכֹּל מַרְאֶה אוֹתְךָ

וְאִם אֶפְתַּח אֶת עֵינַי אֶרְאֶה אוֹתְךָ בְּכָל פְּרָט
בְּהָר וּבְנַחַל בְּרוּחַ קַלָּה הַכֹּל לוֹחֵשׁ אֵין עוֹד מִלְּבַדּוֹ

מָה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ הַשֵּׁם כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ
מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ מָה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ הַשֵּׁם

עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ קוֹל
צִפּוֹר קְטַנָּה עַל עָנָף שֶׁל בֹּקֶר שָׁרָה לְךָ בְּלִי מִלִּים
הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַשְׁפַנִּים
כָּל מָקוֹם וְכָל בְּרִיאָה יֵשׁ לָהּ דֶּרֶךְ וְיֵשׁ לָהּ שִׁירָה

וְאִם אֶפְתַּח אֶת עֵינַי אֶרְאֶה אוֹתְךָ בְּכָל פְּרָט
בְּצֵל וּבְשֶׁמֶשׁ בְּקוֹל צִפּוֹר הַכֹּל מֵאִיר אֶת כְּבוֹדְךָ

מָה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ הַשֵּׁם כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ
מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ מָה רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ הַשֵּׁם

לְפִיכָךְ כָּל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד חַיָּב לוֹמַר בִּשְׁבִילִי נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם
בִּשְׁבִילִי לֹא לְבַדִּי בִּשְׁבִילִי לִרְאוֹת אוֹתְךָ
כָּל מַה שֶּׁבָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא בְּעוֹלָמוֹ לֹא בְרָאוֹ אֶלָּא לִכְבוֹדוֹ

אֵין לְךָ כָּל עֵשֶׂב וָעֵשֶׂב שֶׁאֵין לוֹ מַזָּל בָּרָקִיעַ
שֶׁמַּכֶּה אוֹתוֹ וְאוֹמֵר לוֹ גְּדַל גְּדַל

וְגַם לִי הָעוֹלָם לוֹחֵשׁ בְּכָל יוֹם גְּדַל וּרְאֵה אֶת כְּבוֹד הַשֵּׁם
פְּתַח עֵינֶיךָ פְּתַח לִבְּךָ כָּל הָעוֹלָם קוֹרֵא לְךָ
lyrics_translation:
He who sends springs into the streams, they flow between the mountains.
A drop falls from the sky and the earth smiles in the field.
Wind passes between the trees and the leaves whisper a song.
A stone on the path, shade from the rock — and everything shows You.

And if I open my eyes I'll see You in every detail,
in mountain and stream, in a light breeze — everything whispers there's nothing else.

How great are Your works, God, You made them all with wisdom.
The earth is full of Your possessions. How great are Your works, God.

Above them the birds of the sky dwell, from among the branches they give voice.
A little bird on a morning branch sings to You without words.
The high mountains for the ibex, rocks a shelter for the rabbits.
Every place and every creature has its own path and its own song.

And if I open my eyes I'll see You in every detail,
in shade and sun, in a bird's voice — everything shines with Your glory.

How great are Your works, God, You made them all with wisdom.
The earth is full of Your possessions. How great are Your works, God.

Therefore every single person must say: the world was created for my sake.
For my sake — not alone, for my sake — to see You.
Everything the Holy One created in His world, He created only for His glory.

There isn't a single blade of grass that doesn't have its own star in the sky
that strikes it and tells it: grow, grow.

And the world whispers to me too, every day: grow, and see the glory of God.
Open your eyes, open your heart — the whole world is calling you.
about: "Bishvili Nivra HaOlam," The world was created for me. This song is inspired by the deeper meaning of this timeless teaching. Not that the world exists to serve me, but that everything I encounter was placed before me to reveal something about Hashem. Every mountain and stream, every sunrise and sunset, every joy and challenge is an invitation to recognize His presence. As Baruch Nafshi on Rosh Chodesh celebrate the wonders of creation, so too this song is a reminder that the entire world is speaking, if only we learn to listen.

title: גֶּשֶׁם וְטַל
lyrics_original:
גֶּשֶׁם בִּקַּשְׁנוּ לֶחֶם וְשָׁלוֹם בַּיִת וּפַרְנָסָה אוֹר בְּכָל יוֹם
שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָנוּ שֶׁקֶט שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לָנוּ דַּי שֶׁהַלֵּב יָנוּחַ וְלֹא יִשְׁאַל עַד מָתַי

אַתָּה שׁוֹמֵעַ אֶת הַכְּאֵב שֶׁבַּקּוֹל אֲבָל אַתָּה יוֹדֵעַ מַה מְמַלֵּא אֶת הַכֹּל

גֶּשֶׁם לָאָרֶץ טַל לַנְּשָׁמָה גֶּשֶׁם לְהָקֵל טַל לַשִּׂמְחָה
גֶּשֶׁם מִבַּחוּץ טַל בִּפְנִים אֶהְיֶה כַטַּל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְעוֹלָם לְעוֹלָם לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד

חָשַׁבְנוּ עוֹד קְצָת וְנִהְיֶה שְׂמֵחִים עוֹד כֶּסֶף עוֹד שֶׁקֶט עוֹד יָמִים טוֹבִים
אֲבָל גֶּשֶׁם הוּא לְבוּשׁ עַל הַקֹּר וְהַדְּאָגָה הוּא מֵסִיר אֶת הַמַּכְשׁוֹל אַךְ לֹא מְמַלֵּא נְשָׁמָה

מַה שֶׁבָּא מִבַּחוּץ פֹּותֵחַ שְׁעָרִים אֲבָל רַק טַל מִלְמַעְלָה מְמַלֵּא אֶת הַחַיִּים

גֶּשֶׁם לָאָרֶץ טַל לַנְּשָׁמָה גֶּשֶׁם לְהָקֵל טַל לַשִּׂמְחָה
גֶּשֶׁם מִבַּחוּץ טַל בִּפְנִים אֶהְיֶה כַטַּל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְעוֹלָם לְעוֹלָם לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד

וְיָבוֹא כַגֶּשֶׁם לָנוּ כָּךְ בִּקְּשָׁה יִשְׂרָאֵל דָּבָר שֶׁפְּעָמִים רוֹצִים וּפְעָמִים אֵינוֹ שׁוֹאֵל
וְאַתָּה עָנִיתָ בְּרַחֲמִים גְּדוֹלִים אֶהְיֶה כַטַּל לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְעוֹלָמִים

טַל שֶׁל תְּחִיָּה טַל שֶׁל נְשָׁמָה טַל שֶׁל קִרְבָה טַל שֶׁל שִׂמְחָה

We asked for rain — bread and peace, a home and a livelihood, light every day.
That we'd have quiet, that we'd have enough, that the heart could rest and stop asking "until when."

You hear the pain in the voice, but You know what actually fills everything.

Rain for the earth, dew for the soul. Rain to ease things, dew for joy.
Rain from the outside, dew on the inside. I will be like dew to Israel, forever, forever, forever and ever.

We thought a little more and we'd finally be happy — a little more money, a little more quiet, a few more good days.
But rain is only a covering over the cold and the worry. It removes the obstacle, but it doesn't fill the soul.

What comes from outside opens gates, but only dew from above actually fills a life.

Rain for the earth, dew for the soul. Rain to ease things, dew for joy.
Rain from the outside, dew on the inside. I will be like dew to Israel, forever, forever, forever and ever.

And let it come like rain to us, so Israel asked — something we sometimes want and sometimes don't even ask for.
And You answered with great mercy: I will be like dew to Israel forever.

Dew of revival, dew of the soul, dew of closeness, dew of joy.
Dew in this world, dew for the World to Come — dew that fills me, outside and in.

Rain for the earth, dew for the soul. Rain to ease things, dew for joy.
Rain from the outside, dew on the inside. I will be like dew to Israel, forever, forever, forever and ever.

about:
Why did Chazal say that when Bnei Yisrael asked Hashem for rain, He answered with something even better: dew?

Rain is essential, but it comes and goes. Dew descends quietly every single day. Perhaps the message is that while we naturally pray for Geshem, the physical blessings that sustain our lives, Hashem longs to give us something even greater: the everlasting Tal of Torah, Tal that sustains life. Physical blessings are the means; spiritual growth is the end. Rain nourishes the earth, but dew nourishes the soul. Today, tomorrow, and for eternity.

about: Every generation believed it had finally found a place to belong. We learned the language, built businesses, raised families, and called it home. Our neighbors smiled. The future looked secure. Then, almost without warning, the welcome faded. Doors closed. Friends turned silent. The same story unfolded again and again, across continents and centuries. The lesson never changed: exile can offer comfort, but it can never offer permanence.

lyrics_translation:
I searched on the roads, in faraway cities.
I searched in people, through doors that opened.
And everything I found passed like wind,
and I forgot that inside me there's a place to rest.

So close to me, so far away.
So close to me, so far away.

To touch my soul, the spark You placed inside me,
to fly above the world, to soar toward the light.
To touch my soul, my whole being aches for it —
Master of the world, let me touch it.

Behind all the noise, something hides deep down.
The yetzer pulls downward, the world won't wait,
and the soul inside me still whispers: fly.

To touch my soul, the spark You placed inside me,
to fly above the world, to soar toward the light.
To touch my soul, my whole being aches for it —
Master of the world, let me touch it.

Open a gate inside my heart, remove the screen standing between me and myself.
My whole soul longs, my whole heart pleads — Master of the world, let me come close.

Fly, soar, fly, soar — touch my soul.

To touch my soul, the spark You placed inside me,
to fly above the world, to soar toward the light.
To touch my soul, my whole being aches for it —
Master of the world, let me touch it.

So close to me, so far away.
To touch my soul.
about: We spend our lives searching for happiness, serenity, and a sense of peace, looking for them in places that can never truly satisfy. The soul longs to reconnect with the Divine spark Hashem placed within us, and until that longing is answered, we remain unsettled, no matter how much we achieve. This song is a prayer to quiet the noise, touch the neshamah, and discover the only place where lasting contentment can be found.

title: מי יתן
lyrics_original:
מִי יִתֵּן וְהָיָה לְבָבָם זֶה לָהֶם לְיִרְאָה אֹתִי וְלִשְׁמֹר אֶת כָּל מִצְו‍ֹתַי כָּל הַיָּמִים
וּמִי יִתֵּן כָּל עַם השם נְבִיאִים כִּי יִתֵּן השם אֶת רוּחוֹ עֲלֵיהֶם
lyrics_translation:
If only they would always have this heart, to fear Me and to keep all My commandments all their days, so that it would be well with them and with their children forever.
If only that all of Hashem's people were prophets, that Hashem would place His Spirit upon them.
about: Dedicated to all the great Rebbeim and Morahs who seek no honor other than the honor of Hashem and the well being of their students, whose greatest dream is to see every one of their students grow to become greater than they are.

title: מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה
lyrics_original:
יֵשׁ עוֹלָם שֶׁמִּתְבַּלְבֵּל וְלֹא יוֹדֵעַ מַה לִרְאוֹת
קוֹרֵא לַחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר גָּדוֹל וְלָאוֹר קוֹרֵא חֲלוֹמוֹת
שָׁחֹר נִקְרָא לָבָן וְלָבָן נִקְרָא שָׁחֹר
וַאֲנַחְנוּ מְחַכִּים שֶׁיִּפָּתַח שַׁעַר הָאוֹר

וְאָז נִרְאֶה מַה שֶׁלֹּא רָאִינוּ וְאָז נֵדַע שֶׁלֹּא הָיִינוּ לְבַד

כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים
כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים

אַלְפַּיִם שָׁנָה הָלַכְנוּ עִם דְּמָעוֹת בַּתְּפִלָּה
שָׁאַלְנוּ לָמָּה וְעַד מָתַי וְהַלֵּב לֹא מָצָא מִלָּה
כַּמָּה לֵילוֹת עָבַרְנוּ כַּמָּה דְּרָכִים בְּלִי אוֹר
אַךְ בְּתוֹךְ כָּל דִּמְעָה הָיָה רַחֲמִים גָּדוֹל

וְאָז נִרְאֶה מַה שֶׁלֹּא רָאִינוּ וְאָז נוֹדֶה עַל כָּל הַדֶּרֶךְ יַחַד

כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים
כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים

וְהַיָּם שֶׁל דְּמָעוֹת שֶׁחָשַׁבְנוּ שֶׁבָּא לְהַטְבִּיעַ
יִתְגַּלֶּה כְּיַם רַחֲמִים שֶׁבָּא אוֹתָנוּ לְהַחֲיוֹת
וְכָל מַה שֶׁהָיָה נִסְתָּר יִהְיֶה בָּהִיר וְטוֹב
וְנַעֲמֹד מְלֵאִים תּוֹדָה כִּי הַשֵּׁם הָיָה קָרוֹב

עַל כָּל דִּמְעָה עַל כָּל תְּפִלָּה עַל כָּל לַיְלָה שֶׁהָיָה נִרְאֶה אָרֹךְ
עַל כָּל הַדֶּרֶךְ עַל כָּל הַחֶסֶד עַל הָרַחֲמִים שֶׁלֹּא יָדַעְנוּ לִרְאוֹת

כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים
כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים

כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם
lyrics_translation:
There's a world that's confused, that doesn't know what to look at,
calling darkness a great light, and calling light a dream.
Black is called white, white is called black,
and we're waiting for the gate of light to open.

And then we'll see what we never saw, and then we'll know we were never alone.

For the earth will be filled with knowledge of God, as the waters cover the sea.
For the earth will be filled with knowledge of God, as the waters cover the sea.

Two thousand years we walked with tears in prayer.
We asked why, and until when, and the heart found no words.
So many nights we passed through, so many roads without light —
but inside every tear there was great mercy.

And then we'll see what we never saw, and then we'll give thanks for the whole road together.

For the earth will be filled with knowledge of God, as the waters cover the sea.
For the earth will be filled with knowledge of God, as the waters cover the sea.

And the sea of tears we thought had come to drown us
will reveal itself as a sea of mercy that came to bring us back to life.
And everything that was hidden will become clear and good,
and we'll stand full of gratitude, because God was near.

For every tear, for every prayer, for every night that seemed so long,
for the whole road, for all the kindness, for the mercy we didn't know how to see.

For the earth will be filled with knowledge of God, as the waters cover the sea.
For the earth will be filled with knowledge of God, as the waters cover the sea.

As the waters cover the sea, for the earth will be filled with knowledge of God.
about: Every question we have about life begins with one limitation: we see the world through human eyes instead of through the prism of Hashem. The Navi promises that a day is coming when His presence will be so clear that faith will no longer require effort, and every doubt, every pain, and every mystery will find its place. This song is about that moment, when "מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת הַשֵּׁם כַּמַּיִם לַיָּם מְכַסִּים," and there are no more questions because there is only clarity.

title: סֻלָּם יַעֲקֹב
lyrics_original:
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁרוֹצֶה לָעוּף בְּלִי לָגַעַת בֶּעָפָר
לִהְיוֹת כְּמוֹ מַלְאָךְ וְלִשְׁכֹּחַ אֶת הַמָּחָר
אֲבָל הַסֻּלָּם שֶׁל יַעֲקֹב לֹא הִתְחִיל בַּשָּׁמַיִם
הוּא נָטַע רַגְלַיִם בָּאָרֶץ וְרֹאשׁוֹ נָגַע בַּשָּׁמַיִם

כִּי אֵין עוֹלִים לְמַעְלָה בְּלִי עָפָר עַל הַיָּדַיִם
וְעַד שֶׁמְּקַדְּשִׁים אֶת הָאָרֶץ אֵין נוֹגְעִים בַּשָּׁמַיִם

וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ

מִשְׁפָּטִים הֵם הַשָּׁלָב שֶׁעוֹמֵד עַל הָאֲדָמָה
לֹא לִגְנֹב וְלֹא לִפְגֹּעַ לֹא לִשְׁבֹּר אֶת הַנְּשָׁמָה
קֹדֶם כָּל תִּהְיֶה אָדָם קֹדֶם כָּל תַּעֲמֹד יָשָׁר
כִּי הַנֶּפֶשׁ מִתְקַדֶּשֶׁת כְּשֶׁהָעוֹלָם אֵינוֹ מֻפְקָר

זֶה לֹא נָמוּךְ זֶה הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ שֶׁל הַכֹּל
מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ עוֹמֵד בָּאָרֶץ לֹא יַעֲלֶה בַּקּוֹל

וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ

עֵדוֹת הֵן קוֹל הַלֵּב שֶׁזוֹכֵר לְמִי הוּא שָׁר
שַׁבָּת וּפֶסַח וְסֻכָּה בְּרִית שֶׁלֹּא נִשְׁבַּר
תְּפִלִּין עַל הַזְּרוֹעַ וּתְפִלִּין עַל הָרֹאשׁ
לְהָעִיד בְּכָל יוֹם שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ

כָּאן הָרוּחַ מִתְעוֹרֶרֶת כָּאן הַקֶּשֶׁר מִתְגַּלֶּה
כָּאן הָאָדָם לֹא רַק עוֹשֶׂה הוּא זוֹכֵר לְמִי הוּא עוֹלֶה

וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ

וְיֵשׁ חֻקִּים שֶׁאֵין הַשֵּׂכֶל מַגִּיעַ עַד סוֹדָם
בָּשָׂר בְּחָלָב וְשַׁעַטְנֵז וְאֵפֶר פָּרָה אֲדֻמָּה
כָּאן אֵינֶנִּי אוֹמֵר אֲנִי מֵבִין לָמָּה
כָּאן אֲנִי עוֹלֶה יוֹתֵר כִּי אָמַרְתָּ וְזוֹ נִשְׁמָתִי

כָּאן הַנְּשָׁמָה נוֹגַעַת בְּמַה שֶׁלְּמַעְלָה מִמֶּנִּי
וְדַוְקָא כְּשֶׁאֵינִי מֵבִין אֲנִי יוֹדֵעַ שֶׁאֲנִי שֶׁלְּךָ

וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ

סֻלָּם צוֹם, סֻלָּם קוֹל, סֻלָּם מָמוֹן — כֻּלָּם עוֹלִים לְמָקוֹם עֶלְיוֹן
צוֹם הוּא הַגּוּף שֶׁחוֹזֵר בִּתְשׁוּבָה, קוֹל הוּא הַלֵּב שֶׁעוֹלֶה בִּתְפִלָּה
מָמוֹן הוּא הָאָרֶץ שֶׁנַּעֲשֵׂית צְדָקָה וְכָךְ הָאָדָם עוֹלֶה בַּסֻּלָּם

וְאִם תִּרְצֶה לִהְיוֹת מַלְאָךְ אַל תִּבְרַח מִן הָעוֹלָם
כִּי מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ
עוֹלִים מִן הָאָרֶץ וְיוֹרְדִים לְקַדֵּשׁ אוֹתָהּ
עוֹלִים אֶל הַשָּׁמַיִם וְחוֹזְרִים עִם הַשֵּׁם לְכָאן

וְהִנֵּה סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
וְהִנֵּה מַלְאֲכֵי אֱלֹקִים עֹלִים וְיֹרְדִים בּוֹ

לֹא עוֹלִים לַשָּׁמַיִם בְּלִי לַעֲמֹד בָּאָרֶץ
לֹא עוֹזְבִים אֶת הָעוֹלָם אֶלָּא מַעֲלִים אוֹתוֹ לַשֵּׁם
סֻלָּם מֻצָּב אַרְצָה וְרֹאשׁוֹ מַגִּיעַ הַשָּׁמָיְמָה
lyrics_translation:
Some people want to fly without ever touching the ground,
to be like an angel and forget about tomorrow.
But Jacob's ladder didn't start in the sky 
it planted its feet in the earth, and its head touched heaven.

Because you don't rise up without dirt on your hands,
and until you sanctify the earth, you don't touch the sky.

And behold, a ladder set on the ground, its top reaching the heavens,
and behold, angels of God going up and down on it.

Mishpatim (civil laws) are the rung that stands on the ground —
don't steal, don't hurt, don't break a soul.
First be a person, first stand upright,
because the soul is sanctified when the world isn't lawless.

This isn't the low rung — it's the root of everything.
Whoever doesn't stand on the earth won't rise with any voice.

And behold, a ladder set on the ground, its top reaching the heavens,
and behold, angels of God going up and down on it.

Eidot (testimonies) are the voice of the heart that remembers who it's singing to —
Shabbos, Pesach, Sukkos, a covenant unbroken.
Tefillin on the arm, tefillin on the head,
to testify every day that we belong to the Holy One.

Here the spirit wakes up, here the connection is revealed,
here a person isn't just doing — he remembers who he's rising toward.

And behold, a ladder set on the ground, its top reaching the heavens,
and behold, angels of God going up and down on it.

And there are chukim (statutes) reason can't fully reach —
meat and milk, shatnez, the ashes of the red heifer.
Here I don't say I understand why.
Here I rise even higher, because You said so, and this is my soul.

Here the soul touches something above me,
and precisely when I don't understand, I know that I am Yours.

And behold, a ladder set on the ground, its top reaching the heavens,
and behold, angels of God going up and down on it.

A ladder of fasting, a ladder of voice, a ladder of money — all climbing to a high place.
Fasting is the body doing teshuva, voice is the heart rising in prayer,
money is the earth turned into charity — and so a person climbs the ladder.

And if you want to be an angel, don't run from the world.
Because angels of God go up and down on it —
rising from the earth and descending to sanctify it,
rising to the heavens and coming back down here with God's name.

And behold, a ladder set on the ground, its top reaching the heavens,
and behold, angels of God going up and down on it.

You don't rise to heaven without standing on the earth.
You don't leave the world — you elevate it to God.
A ladder set on the ground, its top reaching the heavens.
about: Some people search for Heaven by leaving the world behind. The Torah teaches the opposite: the way to Heaven begins with your feet firmly planted on the ground.

title: עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם
lyrics_original:
כֻּלָּם מְדַבְּרִים עַל שָׁלוֹם בֵּין עַמִּים וּבֵין גְּבוּלוֹת
שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיוּ עוֹד אַזְעָקוֹת שֶׁיְּלָדִים יִישְׁנוּ בַּלֵּילוֹת
כֻּלָּם רוֹצִים שֶׁהָעוֹלָם יִלְמַד סוֹף סוֹף לִחְיוֹת
שֶׁחֶרֶב לֹא תִּשָּׁלֵף עוֹד וְשֶׁלֹּא נֵדַע מִלְחָמוֹת

זֶה חֲלוֹם גָּדוֹל וְיָקָר אֲבָל הוּא לֹא מַתְחִיל רָחוֹק
הוּא מַתְחִיל בְּמָקוֹם אֶחָד בַּמָּקוֹם שֶׁהוּא הַכִּי קָרוֹב

עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ
וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן

יֵשׁ שָׁכֵן שֶׁכְּבָר לֹא אוֹמְרִים לוֹ בֹּקֶר טוֹב בַּחֲדַר הַמַּדְרֵגוֹת
יֵשׁ חָבֵר שֶׁפַּעַם הָיָה קָרוֹב וְנִשְׁאַר רָחוֹק בִּגְלַל מִלִּים קְטַנּוֹת
יֵשׁ אָדָם שֶׁיּוֹשֵׁב לְיָדְךָ וְכָל שִׂיחָה נִשְׁמַעַת כְּמוֹ מִלְחָמָה
וּלְפָנֵי שֶׁתָּבִיא שָׁלוֹם לָעוֹלָם תַּתְחִיל בָּרְחוֹב שֶׁלְּךָ

בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ לֹא רַק בֵּין גְּבוּלוֹת רְחוֹקִים
בַּקֵּשׁ שָׁלוֹם וְרָדְפֵהוּ בֵּין הָאֲנָשִׁים שֶׁאַתָּה פּוֹגֵשׁ כָּל יוֹם

יֵשׁ שֻׁלְחָן אֶחָד בַּבַּיִת וְכִסֵּא שֶׁנִּשְׁאַר רֵיק
יֵשׁ אָח שֶׁפַּעַם עָמַד קָרוֹב וְהַיּוֹם הוּא כְּבָר רָחוֹק
יֵשׁ מִלָּה שֶׁלֹּא נֶאֶמְרָה וּסְלִיחָה שֶׁעוֹד מְחַכָּה
וּלְפָנֵי שֶׁתָּבִיא שָׁלוֹם לָעוֹלָם תָּבִיא שָׁלוֹם לְתוֹךְ בֵּיתְךָ

עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ
וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן

וּלְפָנֵי שֶׁתַּשְׁלִים אֶת כָּל הָעוֹלָם תַּשְׁלִים עִם עַצְמְךָ
לִפְנֵי שֶׁתְּחַבֵּר לְבָבוֹת רְחוֹקִים תֶּאֱסֹף אֶת הַלֵּב שֶׁבִּפְנִים

יֵשׁ בְּךָ אֵשׁ וְיֵשׁ בְּךָ מַיִם יֵשׁ בְּךָ פַּחַד וְיֵשׁ בְּךָ אוֹר
וּכְשֶׁכָּל הַקּוֹלוֹת שֶׁבְּתוֹכְךָ מַפְסִיקִים לְהִלָּחֵם אַתָּה חוֹזֵר לִהְיוֹת שָׁלֵם

לֹא מָצָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא כְּלִי מַחֲזִיק בְּרָכָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֶלָּא הַשָּׁלוֹם

עוֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ
וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל וְעַל כָּל יוֹשְׁבֵי תֵבֵל וְאִמְרוּ אָמֵן
lyrics_translation:
Everyone talks about peace between nations and borders,
so there won't be sirens anymore, so children can sleep through the night.
Everyone wants the world to finally learn how to live,
so no sword is drawn again and we know war no more.

It's a big, precious dream, but it doesn't start far away.
It starts in one place — the place closest to you.

He who makes peace in His heights, may He make peace upon us,
and upon all of Israel, and say Amen.

There's a neighbor you no longer say good morning to on the stairs.
There's a friend who was once close and stayed distant over small words.
There's someone sitting next to you and every conversation sounds like war.
And before you bring peace to the world, start on your own street.

Seek peace and pursue it — not just between distant borders.
Seek peace and pursue it — between the people you meet every day.

There's one table at home and a chair that stayed empty.
There's a brother who once stood close and today is already far.
There's a word that was never said, and a sorry still waiting.
And before you bring peace to the world, bring peace into your own home.

He who makes peace in His heights, may He make peace upon us,
and upon all of Israel, and say Amen.

And before you make peace with the whole world, make peace with yourself.
Before you connect distant hearts, gather the heart that's inside you.

There's fire in you and there's water in you, there's fear in you and there's light in you.
And when all the voices inside you stop fighting each other, you become whole again.

The Holy One found no vessel that holds blessing for Israel except peace.

He who makes peace in His heights, may He make peace upon us,
and upon all of Israel and all who dwell on earth, and say Amen.
about: Everyone wants world peace, but the song's point is that it starts at your own table, the empty chair, the neighbor you stopped greeting.

title: עַל בְּלִימָה
lyrics_original:
לֹא כָּל אֱמֶת צְרִיכָה קוֹל
לֹא כָּל כְּאֵב צָרִיךְ לָצֵאת
יֵשׁ מִלָּה שֶׁבָּאָה לִשְׂרֹף
וְיֵשׁ שֶׁקֶט שֶׁבָּא לְרַפֵּא
הַגּוּף רוֹצֶה לַעֲנוֹת
הַלֵּב רוֹצֶה לְהַכְרִיעַ
אֲבָל מִי שֶׁבּוֹלֵם אֶת פִּיו
מַצִּיל עוֹלָם בְּלִי לְהוֹדִיעַ

וְאֵין זֶה שֶׁקֶט שֶׁל חֻלְשָׁה וְאֵין זֶה פַּחַד מִן הַקְּרָב
זֶה כֹּחַ שֶׁעוֹמֵד בַּדֶּלֶת וְלֹא נוֹתֵן לָאֵשׁ לִכְתֹּב

כָּל הָעוֹלָם עוֹמֵד עַל פֶּה שֶׁלֹּא נִפְתַּח
עַל לֵב שֶׁבָּעַר בְּתוֹכוֹ וּבָחַר שֶׁלֹּא לִצְרֹחַ
מִלָּה יָכְלָה לִשְׁבֹּר שְׁתִיקָה יָכְלָה לִבְנוֹת
וְאוֹר שֶׁנִּבְרָא בַּסֵּתֶר מֵאִיר בֵּין הַשְּׁתִיקוֹת

כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים עָמַדְתִּי עִם תְּשׁוּבָה עַל הַלָּשׁוֹן
כַּמָּה פְּעָמִים יָדַעְתִּי שֶׁאֲנִי צוֹדֵק בָּרִאשׁוֹן
הָיָה לִי מַה לְהַחֲזִיר הָיָה לִי אֵיךְ לְנַצֵּחַ
אֲבָל הַגּוּף מָצָא מַרְפֵּא כְּשֶׁהַפֶּה לָמַד לָנוּחַ

כִּי חָכְמָה בְּלִי גְּדֵר הִיא רוּחַ בְּלִי בַּיִת

lyrics_translation:
Not every truth needs a voice.
Not every pain needs to come out.
Some words come to burn,
some silence comes to heal.
The body wants to answer back,
the heart wants to have the last word.
But whoever holds his tongue
saves a world without ever announcing it.

And this isn't the silence of weakness, and it isn't fear of the fight.
It's a strength that stands at the door and won't let the fire write.

The whole world stands on a mouth that stayed closed,
on a heart that burned inside and chose not to scream.
A word could have broken it, silence could have built it,
and a light created in secret shines between the silences.

How many times did I stand there with the answer on my tongue,
how many times did I know I was right first.
I had something to fire back, I had a way to win,
but the body found its healing when the mouth learned to rest.

Because wisdom without boundaries is a spirit without a home,
and speech without restraint leaves the heart bare.

The whole world stands on a mouth that stayed closed,
on a heart that burned inside and chose not to scream.
A word could have broken it, silence could have built it,
and a light created in secret shines between the silences.

When my honor shouts and anger wants the floor,
I learn to be mute until the heat passes.
Not mute from Torah, not silent about truth —
just mute from the pride that wants to burn its way out.

If one word is worth something when said at the right time,
then a silence that hurt no one is worth twice as much to the soul.

Master of the world, help me guard my mouth
when I want to hurt, when I want to prove who I am.
Let me hold back the wind, let me choose quiet,
let me be a hero where no one is watching.

Because there's a light you can't see with eyes made of dust,
and there's a reward for a single moment no creature could estimate.
When the world says speak and the heart says answer,
the silence rises up and returns light to the soul.

The whole world stands on a mouth that stayed closed,
on a heart that burned inside and chose not to scream.
A word could have broken it, silence could have built it,
and a light created in secret shines between the silences.

Not every truth needs a voice, not every pain needs to come out.
Some words come to burn, some silence comes to heal.
about: Sometimes the greatest act of strength isn't finding the perfect words, it's having the wisdom to leave them unspoken.

about: Sometimes we stand outside the gates of holiness and wonder why Hashem feels so far away. But perhaps the door was never locked, perhaps He is standing on the other side, waiting for us to open even the smallest crack. We ask Him to open the gates for us, while He asks us to open our hearts to Him, promising that even an opening no wider than a needle can become a doorway as wide as the entrance to the Bais HaMikdash.

title: רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ
lyrics_original:
הַלְּבָנָה נֶעֱלֶמֶת וְהַלַּיְלָה נִשְׁאָר רֵיק
אֲבָל בַּשָּׁמַיִם יוֹדְעִים שֶׁהָאוֹר עוֹד מַחֲזִיק
רַק רֶגַע הִיא נִסְתֶּרֶת רַק רֶגַע בְּלִי קוֹל
וּמִתּוֹךְ הַחֹשֶׁךְ הִיא חוֹזֶרֶת לִגְדֹּל

וְגַם אֲנַחְנוּ כָּךְ קְטַנִּים בַּלַּיְלָה
אֲבָל הַבְּרִית עוֹד חַיָּה וְהַדֶּרֶךְ עוֹד עוֹלָה

וְלַלְּבָנָה אָמַר שֶׁתִּתְחַדֵּשׁ עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת לַעֲמוּסֵי בָטֶן
שֶׁהֵם עֲתִידִים לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ כְּמוֹתָהּ וּלְפָאֵר לְיוֹצְרָם עַל שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ

רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ מְלַחֵשׁ לָנוּ שֶׁשּׁוּם אוֹר לֹא נֶאֱבַד
גַּם אִם הַבַּיִת רָחוֹק הַלֵּב עוֹד עוֹמֵד לְבַד
מִצִּיּוֹן עוֹד קוֹרֵא לָנוּ קוֹל עָתִיק וְקוֹל חָדָשׁ
לֹא רַק לְהַתְחִיל מֵחָדָשׁ אֶלָּא לָשׁוּב אֶל הַמִּקְדָּשׁ

כִּי מַה שֶׁהָיָה שֶׁלָּנוּ לֹא נִלְקַח לְעוֹלָם
וּמַה שֶׁעֲדַיִן נֶחְסָר עוֹד יָשׁוּב בְּרַחֲמִים שְׁלֵמִים

וְלַלְּבָנָה אָמַר שֶׁתִּתְחַדֵּשׁ עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת לַעֲמוּסֵי בָטֶן
שֶׁהֵם עֲתִידִים לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ כְּמוֹתָהּ וּלְפָאֵר לְיוֹצְרָם עַל שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ

מִזְבֵּחַ חָדָשׁ בְּצִיּוֹן תָּכִין וְעוֹלַת רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ נַעֲלֶה עָלָיו
אַהֲבַת עוֹלָם תָּבִיא לָהֶם וּבְרִית אָבוֹת לַבָּנִים תִּזְכֹּר

תָּבִיא אוֹתָנוּ בְּרַחֲמִים אֶל הַקֶּשֶׁר שֶׁלֹּא נִפְסַק
אֶל הָאוֹר שֶׁל רֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ אֶל הַבַּיִת שֶׁעוֹד מְחַכֶּה
לֹא אֶל חֲלוֹם רָחוֹק וְלֹא אֶל זִכָּרוֹן יָשָׁן
אֶל הֶעָתִיד שֶׁהִבְטַחְתָּ אֶל הָאַהֲבָה שֶׁהָיְתָה כָּאן

וְלַלְּבָנָה אָמַר שֶׁתִּתְחַדֵּשׁ עֲטֶרֶת תִּפְאֶרֶת לַעֲמוּסֵי בָטֶן
שֶׁהֵם עֲתִידִים לְהִתְחַדֵּשׁ כְּמוֹתָהּ וּלְפָאֵר לְיוֹצְרָם עַל שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ
lyrics_translation:
The moon disappears and the night stays empty,
but in the heavens they know the light still holds.
Just a moment she's hidden, just a moment without a sound,
and out of the darkness she returns to grow again.

And we're the same way — small in the night —
but the covenant is still alive, and the road still climbs.

And to the moon He said: renew yourself, a crown of glory for those He carried from the womb,
for they too are destined to be renewed like her, and to glorify their Maker for His glorious kingship.

Rosh Chodesh whispers to us that no light is ever truly lost.
Even if home feels far, the heart still stands, not alone.
From Zion a voice still calls us, an ancient voice and a new voice —
not just to start over, but to return to the Mikdash.

Because what was once ours is never taken away forever,
and whatever is still missing will yet return in complete mercy.

And to the moon He said: renew yourself, a crown of glory for those He carried from the womb,
for they too are destined to be renewed like her, and to glorify their Maker for His glorious kingship.

Prepare a new altar in Zion, and let us bring up the Rosh Chodesh offering upon it.
Bring them everlasting love, and remember the covenant of the fathers for the children.

Bring us in mercy to the bond that was never broken,
to the light of Rosh Chodesh, to the home that's still waiting —
not to some distant dream, not to an old memory,
but to the future You promised, to the love that was always here.

And to the moon He said: renew yourself, a crown of glory for those He carried from the womb,
for they too are destined to be renewed like her, and to glorify their Maker for His glorious kingship.
about: The moon disappears for a moment and comes back. Renewal, and a nation that also knows how to disappear for a while and return.

lyrics_translation:
Some hearts are born gentle,
and know how to forgive.

Some hearts are born fiery,
and must learn to overcome.

For some, a smile
comes naturally from within.

For others, every act of peace
is won through blood, sweat, and tears.

Verse 2

When the mind grows weary,
and anger starts to speak,

Everything I've learned
begins to fall apart.

But within the noise
a quiet voice whispers:

"Stop... just one moment...
and you'll become stronger."

One moment,
I stop.

One moment,
I don't break.

One moment,
I don't answer back.

One moment,
and my heart shines.

One moment,
and the fire grows calm.

One moment,
and the soul remembers.

One moment,
and a world is gained.

One moment,
and a person is transformed.

One...
One...
One moment.

One...
One...
And I do not break.

Verse 3

When someone throws hurtful words,
and my heart wants to throw them back...

When I'm about to answer,
just to crush and laugh...

When pride cries out:

"Don't stay silent! Show him who you are!"

Then I take a deep breath...

and remember who I am.

Verse 4

Our nature reacts quickly.

Wisdom arrives later.

When the heart is burning,

Knowledge slips away.

But if, for just one moment,

I guard the gate...

I don't surrender to my nature.

Tomorrow,

I am born again.

Chorus

One moment,
I stop.

One moment,
I don't break.

One moment,
I don't answer back.

One moment,
and my heart shines.

One moment,
and the fire grows calm.

One moment,
and the soul remembers.

One moment,
and a world is gained.

One moment,
and a person is transformed.

Verse 5

Some people receive goodness

As a gift from Heaven.

Others earn it

With sweat

and both hands.

Some never realize

How difficult the battle is.

And for others,

Every moment of silence

Is a victory over themselves.

Verse 6

Don't look at me

And think it's easy.

You cannot see inside

Everything that has fallen.

You cannot see the moment

When I'm fighting.

You cannot see that in my silence

I am acquiring an eternal world.

I wasn't born an angel.

I wasn't given a peaceful heart.

But every time I stop,

I climb one more step.

Not every hero makes noise.

Not every victory can be seen.

Inside the heart...

is where a person is built.

One moment,
I stop.

One moment,
I don't break.

One moment,
I don't answer back.

One moment,
and my heart shines.

One moment,
and the fire grows calm.

One moment,
and the soul remembers.

and a world is gained.

and a person is transformed.

One...

title: רְפָאֵנוּ
lyrics_original:
יֵשׁ עֶצֶם שֶׁנִּשְׁבְּרָה וְיֵשׁ לֵב שֶׁנִּשְׁבַּר
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁנִּלְחָם כָּל בֹּקֶר בְּכְאֵב שֶׁלֹּא נִגְמַר
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁמְּחַכֶּה לִתְשׁוּבָה וּמְפַחֵד מִמַּה שֶׁתָּבוֹא
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁרַק רוֹצֶה לָקוּם לְיוֹם בְּלִי פַּחַד וּבְלִי מוֹרָא

כָּל מַכְאוֹב כָּל מַחֲלָה כָּל לֵב שֶׁמְּבַקֵּשׁ רְפוּאָה
אַתָּה רוֹאֶה מַה שֶׁאֵין אִישׁ רוֹאֶה אַתָּה יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָנוּ שְׁלֵמִים

רְפָאֵנוּ הַשֵּׁם וְנֵרָפֵא הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה
וְהַעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה לְכָל תַּחֲלוּאֵינוּ וּלְכָל מַכְאוֹבֵינוּ כִּי תְהִלָּתֵנוּ אָתָּה

יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁקָּם עִם כְּאֵב כָּל יוֹם וְכָל צַעַד הוּא מִלְחָמָה
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁחַי עִם שָׁעוֹן וְעִם גְּזֵרָה שֶׁלֹּא נֶעֶלְמָה
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁמַּסְתִּיר אֶת הַכֹּל מֵאַחוֹרֵי חִיּוּךְ שָׁקֵט
יֵשׁ מִי שֶׁרַק רוֹצֶה לַעֲלוֹת בַּמַּדְרֵגוֹת בְּלִי לְהִתְמוֹטֵט

כָּל מַכְאוֹב כָּל מַחֲלָה כָּל לֵב שֶׁמְּבַקֵּשׁ רְפוּאָה
אַתָּה רוֹאֶה מַה שֶׁאֵין אִישׁ רוֹאֶה אַתָּה יָכוֹל לַעֲשׂוֹת אוֹתָנוּ שְׁלֵמִים

רְפָאֵנוּ הַשֵּׁם וְנֵרָפֵא הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה
וְהַעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה לְכָל תַּחֲלוּאֵינוּ וּלְכָל מַכְאוֹבֵינוּ כִּי תְהִלָּתֵנוּ אָתָּה

לֹא רַק שֶׁהַפֶּצַע יִסָּגֵר לֹא רַק שֶׁהַכְּאֵב יַעֲבֹר
תֵּן לָנוּ לָקוּם בְּכֹחַ תֵּן לָנוּ לִצְחֹק וְלִזְכֹּר
תֵּן לַיְלָדִים לָרוּץ תֵּן לַיְּגֵעִים לַעֲמֹד
תֵּן לְעַמְּךָ לָקוּם שְׁלֵמִים וּלְהַרְגִּישׁ אֶת הַחַיִּים מְאֹד

רְפָאֵנוּ הַשֵּׁם וְנֵרָפֵא הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ וְנִוָּשֵׁעָה
וְהַעֲלֵה אֲרוּכָה לְכָל תַּחֲלוּאֵינוּ וּלְכָל מַכְאוֹבֵינוּ כִּי תְהִלָּתֵנוּ אָתָּה

תֵּן לְעַמְּךָ לָקוּם שׁוּב בְּרִיאִים וַחֲזָקִים
תֵּן לַצְּחוֹק לְמַלֵּא אֶת הַבָּתִּים תֵּן לַחַיִּים לַחֲזֹר לַפָּנִים

כִּי קֵל מֶלֶך רוֹפֵא נֶאֱמָן וְרַחֲמָן אָתָּה
lyrics_translation:
There's a bone that broke, and there's a heart that broke.
There's someone fighting every morning against pain that never ends.
There's someone waiting for results, afraid of what's coming.
There's someone who just wants to get up to a day without fear.

Every ache, every illness, every heart asking for healing —
You see what no one else sees. You can make us whole again.

Heal us, Hashem, and we will be healed. Save us, and we will be saved.
Bring complete healing to all our sicknesses and all our pains, for You are our praise.

There's someone who gets up with pain every day, and every step is a battle.
There's someone living by the clock, with a diagnosis that hasn't gone away.
There's someone hiding it all behind a quiet smile.
There's someone who just wants to climb the stairs without collapsing.

Every ache, every illness, every heart asking for healing —
You see what no one else sees. You can make us whole again.

Heal us, Hashem, and we will be healed. Save us, and we will be saved.
Bring complete healing to all our sicknesses and all our pains, for You are our praise.

Not just that the wound closes, not just that the pain passes —
let us rise up with strength, let us laugh and remember.
Let the children run, let the weary stand.
Let Your people rise whole and truly feel alive.

Heal us, Hashem, and we will be healed. Save us, and we will be saved.
Bring complete healing to all our sicknesses and all our pains, for You are our praise.

Let Your people rise again, healthy and strong.
Let laughter fill the homes, let life return to their faces.

For God is a faithful, merciful Healer and King.
about: Dedicated to everyone whose daily battle is unseen, whose strength is quiet, and whose hope never fades. May Hashem replace every pain with healing, every fear with peace, and every tear with joy.

title: תִּפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים
lyrics_original:

אַתֶּם מְחָאתֶם כַּפַּיִם כְּאִלּוּ כָּבַשְׁנוּ אֶת הָעוֹלָם מַמָּשׁ
כָּל מִלָּה שֶׁאָמַרְנוּ כָּל צִיּוּר עַל הַשֻּׁלְחָן
הָפַךְ אֶצְלְכֶם לְאוֹצָר לְזִכָּרוֹן שֶׁלֹּא נֶעֱלַם

אַתֶּם רְאִיתֶם בָּנוּ מַה שֶׁעוֹד לֹא יָדַעְנוּ לִרְאוֹת
אַתֶּם הֶאֱמַנְתֶּם בָּנוּ עוֹד לִפְנֵי שֶׁיָּדַעְנוּ מַה לִּהְיוֹת

עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם
אֲנַחְנוּ הָיִינוּ הַכֶּתֶר שֶׁלָּכֶם וְאַתֶּם הַתִּפְאֶרֶת שֶׁלָּנוּ לְעוֹלָם

כְּשֶׁגָּדַלְנוּ הָיִינוּ עֲסוּקִים וְהַיָּמִים רָצוּ מַהֵר
לֹא תָּמִיד עָצַרְנוּ לִשְׁאֹל מֵאַיִן הַכֹּל הִתְחִיל
מִי נָשָׂא אֶת הַשֵּׁמוֹת מִי שָׁמַר אֶת הַסִּפּוּר
מִי הֶעֱבִיר לָנוּ בְּשֶׁקֶט אֶת הַנִּגּוּן מִדּוֹר לְדוֹר

הַיּוֹם אֲנַחְנוּ מַבִּיטִים וּמַתְחִילִים סוֹף סוֹף לִרְאוֹת
כַּמָּה כֹּחַ הָיָה בַּדֶּרֶךְ כַּמָּה אוֹר בֵּין הַדְּמָעוֹת

עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם
אֲנַחְנוּ הָיִינוּ הַכֶּתֶר שֶׁלָּכֶם וְאַתֶּם הַתִּפְאֶרֶת שֶׁלָּנוּ לְעוֹלָם

זְכֹר יְמוֹת עוֹלָם בִּינוּ שְׁנוֹת דֹּר וָדֹר
שְׁאַל אָבִיךָ וְיַגֵּדְךָ זְקֵנֶיךָ וְיֹאמְרוּ לָך

יֵשׁ סִפּוּר בְּכָל קֶמֶט יֵשׁ תְּפִלָּה בְּכָל מַבָּט

וְאִם פַּעַם אַתֶּם עָמַדְתֶּם וּמְחָאתֶם לָנוּ כַּפַּיִם
הַיּוֹם אֲנַחְנוּ עוֹמְדִים וּמוֹחֲאִים לָכֶם פִּי שְׁנַיִם

עֲטֶרֶת זְקֵנִים בְּנֵי בָנִים וְתִפְאֶרֶת בָּנִים אֲבוֹתָם

אַתֶּם הַשֹּׁרֶשׁ וַאֲנַחְנוּ הָעֲנָפִים
אַתֶּם הַסִּפּוּר שֶׁאֲנַחְנוּ מַמְשִׁיכִים
וְכָל מַה שֶּׁיָּפֶה בָּנוּ הִתְחִיל אֵצְלְכֶם בַּפְּנִים

lyrics_translation:
When we were still small and every step was new,
you clapped your hands like we'd conquered the whole world.
Every word we said, every drawing on the table,
became a treasure to you, a memory that never faded.

You saw in us what we didn't yet know how to see in ourselves.
You believed in us before we even knew what we'd become.

Grandchildren are the crown of the old, and parents are the glory of children.
We were your crown — and you are our glory, forever.

When we grew up we got busy, and the days moved fast.
We didn't always stop to ask where it all began,
who carried the names, who kept the story,
who quietly passed the melody down from generation to generation.

Today we're looking back and finally starting to see
how much strength was on that road, how much light between the tears.

Grandchildren are the crown of the old, and parents are the glory of children.
We were your crown — and you are our glory, forever.

Remember the days of old, understand the years of generation after generation.
Ask your father and he will tell you, your elders, and they will say to you.

There's a story in every wrinkle, a prayer in every glance.
There's a whole world that slowly made its way down to us.
And if you once stood and clapped for us,
today we stand and clap for you twice as loud.

Grandchildren are the crown of the old, and parents are the glory of children.
We were your crown — and you are our glory, forever.

You are the root and we are the branches.
You are the story we get to continue.
And everything beautiful in us started inside you.

Grandchildren are the crown of the old, and parents are the glory of children.
about: Love begins in one direction, from parent to child. It reaches its fullness when the child matures and the relationship comes full circle. The children become the parents' crown, and the parents become the children's glory.
